title: Fruit by Supergood  Pineapple Coconut & Nectarine 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Pineapple, Coconut and Nectarine is a smooth and creamy tropical treat. It features the sweet, exotic taste of Pineapple and Nectarine, perfectly rounded off with a smooth, rich layer of Coconut. It evokes the relaxed luxury of a holiday cocktail, delivering a sunny and decadent vape. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with low-wattage pod kits and starter vape kits, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable. Fruit by Supergood Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
